system.description:
Tianqi Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Legendary[1], Salt. No item slots.

You have inherited the greatest gift of the Tianqi - genetic lineage from the Ascendants themselves.

Touching Gold (Passive): Through your divine blood, you can touch and interact with gold.

Commanding Presence (Passive): People tend to listen to you, and you have a commanding presence. If you are a soldier, gain 1 extra Call Point beginning at Level 6.

Boriand’s Blessing (Passive): Beginning at Level 11, you gain the notice of nobility. You are given a minor Boriandship. Gain 1 Influence with a Tianqi City of your choosing.

Rulebook p.67.
